parts.text: Hello! I just had my car hit by another driver. Can you help me understand what ClaimArmor AI can do for me?
My 2022 Honda Civic with 18,000 miles was totaled and repaired. The insurance company says there is no diminished value. Is that true and how is it calculated?
My car is 2 years old and the insurance company wants to use aftermarket parts. My policy says: 'OEM parts are required for vehicles under 3 years old.' Can they do this?
